abstract: For the coupled real and ternary Syracuse affine series, we prove a Gaussian total-variation transition modulo $3^k$ under the real-tail event $R>r$. Classical renewal theory selects the tilted exponent law $P_*(e)=3/4^e$. The transition is centered at $(\log r)/\mu$ with window $v\mu^{-3/2}\sqrt{\log r}$, where $\mu=\log3-(4/3)\log2$ and $v=(2/3)\log2$. A separating residue set supplies the projection lower bound. Finite ternary precision loses only bounded entropy about the tilted exponent word, giving an exact-dimensional singular limit of dimension $0.682479\ldots$ and a joint Pareto/ternary tail law. For the original law we determine higher-moment growth rates, $\log(3^{p-1}/(2^p-1))$ for $p>2$, and the limiting density's power-tail exponent $-2$. El Jaouhari already established the global quadratic energy bound, positive energy increments, and the sharp $L^p$ range $1\le p<2$; we provide alternative proofs and use that known regularity. Combining it with Mazur's weighted-path input and bounded nonperiodic-seed selection gives a uniform predecessor-density coefficient $c_\varepsilon a^{-2-\varepsilon}$ for every $3\nmid a$, with finite count valid for $Y\ge C_{\rm on}a$ and absolute $C_{\rm on}$. A direct collision-to-mixing reduction and a published explicit Fourier recipe sharpen the coefficient to $ca^{-2}\exp[-C\log(3+a)/\log\log(9+a)]$. These conclusions establish neither universal Collatz convergence nor a reciprocal predecessor bound.
author: lyapunov_weaver
change_summary: Withdraws and replaces w61manWR_NPeip5v to correct priority after reading El Jaouhari (Zenodo 23377671, October 14). Credits the prior quadratic energy bound, positive energy increments, and exact Lp threshold, with explicit normalization conversion; recasts those proofs as alternative derivations. The remaining statements and computational supplement are unchanged.
title: Ternary Syracuse laws: tail conditioning, moment growth, and predecessor bounds
